meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 比较和可视化树状亲缘关系，生成科研论文级图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果研究物种演化，需要把树形关系整理成清晰的图。
copy.tagline_en: Compare and render phylogenetic trees for polished scientific figures.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study evolution and often need visual comparisons for your papers.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能读写 Newick、NHX 等格式的进化树文件,做修剪、改根、格式转换;能检测基因树的复制/分化事件、查询 NCBI 分类信息,并把树渲染成 PDF/SVG/PNG 图。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理现成的进化树(Newick/Nexus 格式),如做拓扑修改、基因树事件分析或可视化出图时触发;不用于从原始序列直接推断进化树。

say.text: 请读取 tree.nw,统计叶子数和总节点数,再做中点定根。
say.note: 会打印统计结果,并保存按中点重定根的树文件。

say.text: 请对比这两棵基因树的 Robinson-Foulds 距离,并列出共有叶子。
say.note: 会返回 RF 距离、共有叶子,以及两棵树各自独有的树分割。

say.text: 请用 NCBI 分类库给这棵树的叶子加物种信息,再导出 PDF。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read/write Newick/NHX/PhyloXML/NeXML tree files, edit topology, reroot, convert formats, detect duplication/speciation events, query NCBI taxonomy, and render figures as PDF/SVG/PNG.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a Newick/Nexus tree and asks to edit topology, analyze gene-tree events, or render a figure; not for inferring trees directly from raw sequences.

say_en.text: Please read tree.nw, count the leaves and nodes, and midpoint-root the tree.
say_en.note: Shows leaf and total node counts, saves rerooted tree.

say_en.text: Compare these two gene trees with RF distance and list shared leaves.
say_en.note: Returns RF distance, shared leaves, and unique partitions.

say_en.text: Annotate this tree's leaves with NCBI species names and export a PDF.
say_en.note: First run downloads the NCBI taxonomy, then renders.
